entries.title: Exodus 37:1
segments: ¶Then Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood; two and a half cubits [was] its length, a cubit and a half its width, and a cubit and a half its height.

entries.title: Exodus 37:2
segments: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold all around it.

entries.title: Exodus 37:3
segments: And he cast for it four rings of gold [to be set] in its four corners: two rings on one side, and two rings on the other side of it.

entries.title: Exodus 37:4
segments: He made poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.

entries.title: Exodus 37:5
segments: And he put the poles into the rings at the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

entries.title: Exodus 37:6
segments: He also made the mercy seat of pure gold; two and a half cubits [was] its length and a cubit and a half its width.

entries.title: Exodus 37:7
segments: He made two cherubim of beaten gold; he made them of one piece at the two ends of the mercy seat:

entries.title: Exodus 37:8
segments: one cherub at one end on this side, and the other cherub at the [other] end on that side. He made the cherubim at the two ends [of one piece] with the mercy seat.

entries.title: Exodus 37:9
segments: The cherubim spread out [their] wings above, [and] covered the mercy seat with their wings. They faced one another; the faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.

entries.title: Exodus 37:10
segments: ¶He made the table of acacia wood; two cubits [was] its length, a cubit its width, and a cubit and a half its height.

entries.title: Exodus 37:11
segments: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made a molding of gold all around it.

entries.title: Exodus 37:12
segments: Also he made a frame of a handbreadth all around it, and made a molding of gold for the frame all around it.

entries.title: Exodus 37:13
segments: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings on the four corners that [were] at its four legs.

entries.title: Exodus 37:14
segments: The rings were close to the frame, as holders for the poles to bear the table.

entries.title: Exodus 37:15
segments: And he made the poles of acacia wood to bear the table, and overlaid them with gold.

entries.title: Exodus 37:16
segments: He made of pure gold the utensils which were on the table: its dishes, its cups, its bowls, and its pitchers for pouring.

entries.title: Exodus 37:17
segments: He also made the lampstand of pure gold; of hammered work he made the lampstand. Its shaft, its branches, its bowls, its [ornamental] knobs, and its flowers were of the same piece.

entries.title: Exodus 37:18
segments: And six branches came out of its sides: three branches of the lampstand out of one side, and three branches of the lampstand out of the other side.

entries.title: Exodus 37:19
segments: There were three bowls made like almond [blossoms] on one branch, with an [ornamental] knob and a flower, and three bowls made like almond [blossoms] on the other branch, with an [ornamental] knob and a flower-and so for the six branches coming out of the lampstand.

entries.title: Exodus 37:20
segments: And on the lampstand itself [were] four bowls made like almond [blossoms, each with] its [ornamental] knob and flower.

entries.title: Exodus 37:21
segments: [There was] a knob under the [first] two branches of the same, a knob under the [second] two branches of the same, and a knob under the [third] two branches of the same, according to the six branches extending from it.

entries.title: Exodus 37:22
segments: Their knobs and their branches were of one piece; all of it [was] one hammered piece of pure gold.

entries.title: Exodus 37:23
segments: And he made its seven lamps, its wick-trimmers, and its trays of pure gold.

entries.title: Exodus 37:24
segments: Of a talent of pure gold he made it, with all its utensils.

entries.title: Exodus 37:25
segments: ¶He made the incense altar of acacia wood. Its length [was] a cubit and its width a cubit-[it was] square-and two cubits [was] its height. Its horns were [of one piece] with it.

entries.title: Exodus 37:26
segments: And he overlaid it with pure gold: its top, its sides all around, and its horns. He also made for it a molding of gold all around it.

entries.title: Exodus 37:27
segments: He made two rings of gold for it under its molding, by its two corners on both sides, as holders for the poles with which to bear it.

entries.title: Exodus 37:28
segments: And he made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.

entries.title: Exodus 37:29
segments: He also made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the perfumer.
